title: In-Place Modification
goal: Learn how to filter and modify collections safely without borrow conflicts.

sections.text: Modifying a vector while iterating over it with a `for` loop causes borrow checker errors.

sections.caption: Iterating borrows v, blocking mutation.

sections.text: To keep only items that match a condition, use `v.retain()`. It modifies the vector in place.

sections.caption: retain keeps elements matching the predicate.

sections.text: The closure passed to `retain` receives a reference `&T` to each item. Dereference with `*` or pattern match with `|&x|` to test the value.

sections.code:
let mut v = vec![-1, 2, -3, 4];
v.retain(|&x| x > 0);
sections.caption: Pattern matching |&x| unwraps the reference.

sections.text: Filtering into a new vector using iterators is covered in the Build the Iterator deck later.

explanation: Learn how to filter and modify collections safely without borrow conflicts.
